notes:
Account background: Pixelforge builds an in-app AI assistant for product teams (task assist, doc search, conversational troubleshooting). Currently using another LLM API (primary production traffic on OpenAI). Mid-market buyer: product + infra + security. Interested in Redwood Hosted as drop-in replacement for immediate cost/perf tests, then Dedicated (VPC + reserved GPUs) for 2025 rollout.

Sales/AE notes (Jordan): quick adoption signal — CTO demoed internally and got strong exec appetite. Pricing sensitivity moderate; main ask = predictable unit economics once we move off public vendor. They expressed: "We need parity with existing prompts — no visible regressions to users".

Technical contact: VP Eng (Maya Chen); Security lead: Liam O'Connor. SE engaged (Aisha Kapoor) doing integration runbook.

Key pain: unpredictable costs and occasional rate-limits from current provider during spikes. Would like autoscaling and graceful fallback to cheaper model variants.

POC started: Hosted POC launched 2024-10-08, ran sample traffic and automated evals. Results: latency improved p50 by ~18%, cost per 1k tokens down ~12% on sample workload. Observed prompt-output drift on some templates (stop token handling + few-shot formatting). Logged as INF-4421.

Quote from 10/22 call: "If we can get 95% prompt parity and a clear migration plan to Dedicated, we'll sign for reserved capacity — need a price/commit that matches our Q1 forecast."

Next steps owner map: Jordan — pricing deck and committed quote; Aisha — 2-week dedicated POC plan + infra checklist; Maya — security sign-off timeline.
